summary:
Plan for migrate-kb-2 (migration-tools#r1-r17): 6 red tests of 43 go green.
Code: migrate_ledger.py reads a supersedes naming several decisions (split at 'and' between decision refs), marks each superseded, writes one target as a scalar and several as a list (r2, r17); a qualifier goes to by only when there is one.
migrate_spec.py: plan_references also rewrites the decision texts plan_ledger creates, so by and body paths follow moved files (r5, r16, r6).
Tests: the status step strips backticks and gets a two-file form; the three-entry, 'supersedes naming X and Y', source-with-quotes, docs/superpowers/specs/s1.md and records/logs/README.md Givens and the README Then are added.
No existing test breaks: the scalar supersedes Thens stay valid.
Dropped from the researcher's set as unchanged: scripts/migrate, migrate_layout.py, migration_old.py, test_migrate_layout.py.
Open: qualified multi-target by, other separators, D3 dangling supersedes, model check on a supersedes list.
